run_export_depth_images: run the script with --export_depth_images to extract depth images from scannet .sens files
run_export_color_images: run the script with --export_color_images to extract color images from scannet .sens files
run_export_poses: run the script with --export_poses to extract camera poses from scannet .sens files
run_export_intrinsics: run the script with --export_intrinsics to extract camera intrinsics from scannet .sens files
run_export_all: run the script with all export flags to extract depth, color, poses, and intrinsics from scannet scans
